_NOTE: Wholesale / reseller rate card, Singapore. Source of truth for every partner brief and trade quote. Set 17 Sep 2026 by Alex against the costing calculator: cost base SGD 27.63/roasted kg at a 6.00 green-kg roast fee, blended freight 0.59/kg carrying 30 kg minimum drops. Every rung nets 30%+ after rebate and contribution. Do not type these numbers into a client file: read them from here.
_RULE: net = list - (rebate% x list) - contribution per kg - cost, measured against cash received (list x (1 - rebate%)). Must not fall below MIN_NET_PCT. build_brief.py asserts this on every build.
REBATE_BASIS: invoiced value as adjusted for the volume tier
REBATE_FREQUENCY: twice yearly in arrears, by credit note
TIER_BASIS_Y1: retrospective: invoiced at the entry rate, the better rate applied to all volume bought and the difference credited at twelve months
TIER_BASIS_Y2: set in advance on the preceding twelve months, reviewed at each rebate date
TIER_DOWNWARD: a fall to a lower band takes effect at the next review and is never clawed back
_NOTE_SETTLEMENT: Settle the volume tier FIRST, then calculate the 5% rebate and the conservation share on the adjusted value. Calculating either on the provisional entry price costs 0.1 to 0.4 of a margin point and pays the forest on money that was refunded.
_NOTE_ENTRY_BAND: Entry band starts at the minimum order, not at an annual floor. There is no minimum annual volume: a floor would be a commitment, and year one is deliberately measured rather than committed.
DELIVERY_DAYS: the Friday or the Monday after
_NOTE_CYCLE: Friday 17:00 cut-off sits ahead of Compound's Monday noon weekly cut-off, so a Lyreco order always makes the same week's roast plan. Do not move the cut-off later without checking that against the roaster.
CONTRIB_BASIS: flat amount per kilogram, identical on every tier, not a percentage of price
_NOTE_CONTRIB: Flat 2.25 chosen 17 Sep 2026 so it matches the figure published on nofilter.sg, can be printed in a partner catalogue without qualification, and can never be overstated as the tier falls. At the top tier it is 5.3% of price rather than 5%, which the rungs absorb.
GOVERNING_LAW: Singapore law, with the courts of Singapore having exclusive jurisdiction
_NOTE_AGREEMENT: This document IS the supply agreement; nothing separate follows. Any clause the parties need must be on these pages. Currently carried: price, rebate, contribution, format, territory, delivery, roasting cycle, payment, price validity, stock, claims, term and notice, governing law.
_NOTE_PARTNERS: Partner identity lives in partners/<name>.json and is merged over this card at build time. This file carries price and terms only, so every SG reseller is quoted from the same numbers.
